_why: One table, three readers. cardCell in nala-shared.js is the only thing that says where a villa's key cards stand, and the Front Desk, the Dashboard and (in spirit) the Windows helper all answer to it. The helper cannot import from the site - the normalisePhone situation again - so its copy of the state words is held to THIS file by its own test. A case added here fails whichever reader has not learned it. k doubles as the style hook, and the colour each k wears is the colour law's: queued cream, writing amber, done green, failed red, cancelled and none grey.

cases.label: no cards yet
cases.why: no job written for the villa today

cases.label: to encode
cases.why: the desk pressed Issue, the helper has not picked it up

cases.label: writing card 1 of 2
cases.why: the helper is on the first card

cases.label: writing card 2 of 2
cases.why: one written, one to go - written counts FINISHED cards

cases.label: 1 card issued
cases.why: singular, because the row is read aloud at the desk

cases.label: write failed
cases.why: red is failure only, and this is one

cases.label: cancelled
cases.why: walked back on purpose - grey, not red, nothing to do here

cases.label: to encode
cases.why: an unknown state reads as work to do, never as done: the safe wrong answer is the one that makes somebody look
